safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

benefits.text: A concealer with densely concentrated covering pigments that provides perfect coverage, creating smooth, flawless skin. The ultra-natural coverage formula helps perfectly cover skin imperfections with just a small amount.

howToUse.text: Use to cover imperfections on the skin, then apply foundation, powder,...

positioning.text: A single matte yellow beige eyeshadow, used as a natural eye base color that is bright, clean and easy to pair.

sellingPoints.text: 1-color eyeshadow; thin, lightweight powder; refined color that blends into the skin.

texture.text: Single pressed eyeshadow, thin and lightweight.

finish.text: Natural matte / yellow beige / soft eye base.

claimDisclaimers.text: In the Syndication source, the content for V006/V007 contains a passage mixed up with a concealer description, so use only the safe general claims of the single eyeshadow line.
